additional_info.body:
Dear Sumit,
Thank you for contacting eMobility support.
After carefully deepdiving in the logs of the timestamps you send to us, we found that during these timestamps there was an connection error during the session.
This is why the SECC went offline, as the charger needs to be connected, for the SECC to be connected.
At this moment i see that the charger is in a healthy state, and i don`t see any live errors:
Please provide us with feedback if this email answered your question, so we can close the ticket.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
